title: Nixtamal
origin: Migrated from Oaxaca Casa Crespo/Nixtamal.docx (file dated 2024-03-07)

steps.action: Heat in a clay, stainless, or pewter pot:
When hot, add; boil 3 min, cover, remove from heat, rest 30 min:
items: 2 Tbsp cal (food-grade slaked lime), dissolved in ½ cup water
1 kg dried field corn (2.2 lb), cleaned

steps.action: Drain off the cooking liquid (nejayote); rest overnight.
Next day, rinse, drain, and grind with a little water:

items.text: Metate, hand mill, meat grinder, or a public mill

edits: Source says "lime (calcium oxide)". Nixtamal uses cal, which is calcium hydroxide (slaked lime); calcium oxide is quicklime and is caustic
